reviews.title: AS2 runtime two-hour delivery: connections

reviews.limitations: Rust LocalConnection protocol/pending state over actual same-origin BroadcastChannel and Web Locks, plus owned AMF0 HTTP remoting with actual endpoint responses. Browser-local asynchronous name reservations, no cross-origin/machine-wide guarantees, XMLSocket TCP or RTMP. No AMF3 envelopes, class aliases or complete remoting protocol. NetConnection.close is a source-reviewed stale correction. Delivery observations: Ordinary export passed 9/0 initial and 13/0 after actual HTTP AMF0 echo and status-fault responses. Two same-origin browser tabs exchanged A-to-B and B-to-A messages, then closed/reclaimed receiver A. This does not establish other browsers, cross-origin or machine-wide delivery.

reviews.limitations: Rust project-contained nested AS2 resource includes with diagnostic origin mapping, plus Rust Locale plain-field replacement plans applied before successful XLIFF load callbacks. No arbitrary disk/network includes, AS2 class-unit includes, initclip/intrinsic or editor Strings panel; no rich text or full historical Locale semantics. Delivery observations: Ordinary includes/Locale export passed 6/0 initially and 11/0 after the real reload button, with nested resources and visible automatic/manual plain-field replacement. Compiler checks cover bounded include diagnostics separately; no authoring UI or original Flash comparison was run.

reviews.title: AS2 runtime two-hour delivery: print
reviews.reason: Bounded AS2-only delivery against fea2333. New implementations, extensions and corrections are accounted separately. Whole-family checks do not imply individual declaration or original Flash conformance. AS3 entries are unchanged.
reviews.limitations: Rust scene capture/PNG and print policy produce bitmap pages for an owned browser print window. CSS A4 portrait/36-point margins are explicit virtual output geometry, never physical printer facts. Explicit bitmap/current-frame profile only; no physical printing or original Flash dialog/device parity. Delivery observations: An actual Print scene click successfully captured two bitmap pages, with two true addPage results, virtual printable geometry 523x770 and paper 595x842 portrait, and invoked send without a recorded console error. The owned popup was not exposed among available browser tabs. Visual print-preview content, system print dialog and cancellation were not verified; no physical printing was performed or claimed.
